hosted_trial_metrics: Duration: 2 weeks; sample traffic from 15k seeded users
Observed avg QPS (trial window): 6.8 QPS (overall), peak burst observed 22 QPS
Average tokens per request: 420 (input 120 / output 300), token distribution skewed to long-form support replies
Avg session concurrency: 8 concurrent threads per team; peak concurrency on weekdays ~28
Avg p50 latency (hosted): 320ms for chosen model; p95 ~980ms (spiky at peak)
Daily token volume (trial): 180k - 240k tokens/day during trial ramp
dedicated_capacity_request: Business ask: predictable p95 < 450ms at peak; remove p95 spikes caused by noisy neighbor effects
Initial sizing ask: support sustained 100 QPS peak (15% headroom) with burst to 180 QPS for short windows
Concurrency target: sustained 35 concurrent generation contexts, target ephemeral concurrency cushion of +20%
Token mix target: 70% generation-heavy chat (avg 420 tokens), 20% embeddings calls (short payloads), 10% reranking/fast queries
Projected daily tokens at scale: 6M - 10M tokens/day depending on adoption curve
Recommended starting config (Redwood Dedicated): 2 x high-memory GPU nodes with autoscale for +1 node at 70% utilization
Fallback plan: automatic routing to smaller quantized variant for non-critical tenants during peak
traffic_forecast_and_cost_notes: Baseline forecast month 1 post-dedicated: 1.8M tokens/day (conservative), month 6: 6.5M tokens/day (mid-case)
QPS mapping: 100 QPS sustained ~ corresponds to ~3.6M tokens/hour assuming avg 420 tokens/request
Economics ask: want to see 25-35% cost reduction vs current hosted on-demand with 12-mo commit
Pricing sensitivity: threshold is $X per 1M tokens (customer asked to map to $/token for reserved capacity) — finance call to align
Ops ask: grace period for scale-up during initial 30 days while traffic profile stabilizes
technical_risks_and_requirements: DLP / PII redaction flow must be validated prior to production — required in contracts
KMS integration for key rotation — engineering lead assigned to test in staging
Network: prefer VPC peering to us-east-1 with restricted egress; egress audit log requirement
Canary rollout: requested 10% traffic canary for 3 days before full cutover
Observability: token-level cost breakdown per route required for finance reporting

4) Include canary and fallback routing policies in SOW; contractual SLA for latency and availability
5) Align on pricing mechanics: blended $/1M token for committed tiers and overage rules
